truth_evidence: Affected every release before 5.4 (in practice 5.1 onwards, when FullLoader appeared). Fixed in 5.4.
Fix commit a001f27 'Fix for CVE-2020-14343', in tag 5.4 and not in 5.3.1. https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/commit/a001f2782501ad2d24986959f0239a354675f9dc

The whole change is at module level in lib/yaml/constructor.py and lib3/yaml/constructor.py: the add_multi_constructor registrations for python/module, python/object and python/object/new move from FullConstructor to UnsafeConstructor. No function body changes.
The constructors whose registration moved (construct_python_module, construct_python_object, construct_python_object_new) are unchanged and so not listed as modified.
Entry points: everything that loads with FullLoader, including yaml.load/yaml.load_all without a Loader.
notes: The design document's example record for this ID lists construct_python_object_new and set_python_instance_state as 'modified in a001f27'. The commit does not modify any function; the example was illustrative and this file is the truth.
